sonnet.problem: The joke sets Papa Dorin's blurry cookie stamping against 'works among them that no one else did,' which are Jesus' own works. That puts Jesus' works inside the joke and trivializes them, instead of keeping the comparison on the human side of the moment.
sonnet.rule: Comparisons stay on the human side of the moment.

sonnet.problem: The card only retells John 16:4b, which the baker just answered on card 9, and then adds the 'not done' line. The retelling is a recap that moves the passage nowhere.
sonnet.rule: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.
